name: L0pht Heavy Industries
description: L0pht Heavy Industries was a pioneering American hacker collective based in Boston, active 1992-2000. The group pioneered responsible disclosure and in 1998 famously testified before the US Senate, claiming they could take down the entire internet in 30 minutes. Members created the L0phtCrack password auditing tool. The group later became @stake, a security consultancy acquired by Symantec.
